page.overview:
Who is Alexander Luthor?

On Lex's birthday, a mysterious man came to his house and offered him a job working on a classified project, saying that he would pay Luthor whatever he wanted. However, Lex refused as he did not want to take a job which would take him away from his family.

The man told Luthor that he lacked the unquenchable ambition he was meant to have. He revealed his true identity as Brainiac and said that he would "motivate" Luthor to do what he needed.

Brainiac forced Lex to watch as he slaughtered Lex's family and friends and then left, telling the devastated Lex to make himself "interesting".
